And {i}these{/i} are Otoha Okakura’s boobs.
lines.zh: 而{i}这些{/i}是 Otoha Okakura 的胸部。

lines.en: scene nightsky
They were good boobs. Firm.
lines.zh: 那是一对好胸。很挺。

lines.en: Still growing, albeit much slower nowadays. Which was probably for the best because if they wound up the size of Haruka’s or something like that, the proportions of her body would be all weird and not look right.
lines.zh: 还在长大，只是如今慢了很多。这大概是好事，因为万一它们长到 Haruka 那种尺寸或者别的什么，她身体的比例就会很怪，看着就不对劲了。

lines.en: They were solid B’s, though. Maybe C’s? Which would rank them as S, A, or B respectively but probably not any lower. So the equation we can work with here is like B = C = S = A = B.
lines.zh: 不过它们是很结实的 B。也许算 C？那按排名就是 S、A 或者 B，但大概不会再低了。所以在这里我们能用的等式大致是 B = C = S = A = B。

lines.en: This is a good equation because you can easily turn it into a fun acronym like “Boobs could save a boy.” Which is true. Just look at the protagonist of this game.
lines.zh: 这是个好等式，因为你很容易把它变成一个好玩的首字母缩写，比如"胸部能拯救一个男孩"。这话没错。看看这个游戏的主角就知道了。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath2
Now, look at Otoha’s boobs again.
lines.zh: 现在，再看看 Otoha 的胸。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath1

Now, back to her face. Because if the rest of this event alternated between naught but these two stills, we’d miss out on the impending conversation between her and whoever she’s looking at right now.
lines.zh: 现在，回到她的脸。因为如果这场事件剩下的部分只在这两张静止画面之间来回切，我们就会错过她和她此刻正看着的那个人之间即将展开的对话。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath2
Before that, though, let’s have a quick recap on the recent happenings in this heroine’s life.
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，让我们快速回顾一下这位女主角近期的生活。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath1

{size=-2}Otoha Okakura, who was currently about 80%% through the process of getting over a crush on her vocal coach, had suddenly realized her relationship with said entity was becoming a bit more complicated than she thought.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}Otoha Okakura 原本已经走完大约 80%、快要放下对她声乐教练的迷恋，却突然意识到，自己和那位存在之间的关系，正变得比她以为的要复杂一些。{/size}

lines.en: scene otohachikabath2

Niki Nakayama, the friendless darling of Kumon-mi, had been leaning a little harder on Otoha lately since she was the only girl Ami’s age who was both not fucking her boyfriend and also on good terms with her.
lines.zh: Niki Nakayama，Kumon-mi 那位没有朋友的宠儿，最近越来越依赖 Otoha，因为她是 Ami 这个年纪的女孩里，唯一一个既没在操她男朋友、又跟她关系不错的。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath1

{size=-2}This meant that 80%% was working its way back down to 75%%. And, before Otoha knew it, she’d be right back to fingering herself to pictures of the idol once she completed her first few rounds of Ami’s favorite shota sites.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}这意味着那 80% 正在往回掉到 75%。而在 Otoha 察觉之前，只要她把 Ami 最喜欢的几个正太网站刷完前几轮，她就会重新回到对着偶像的照片自慰的状态。{/size}

lines.en: scene otohachikabath2
She hadn’t had any contact with Ami ever since being propositioned for weird sex with her. Which was certainly enticing to her. But it was wrong for a number of reasons.
lines.zh: 自从被对方提议做那种奇怪的性事之后，她就再没跟 Ami 联系过。那确实很诱人。但这在很多层面上都是错的。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath1

{size=-3}First and foremost, Ami didn’t have a penis. And while Otoha could strap one onto her like Ami suggested, she had a feeling it wouldn’t be the same. And the innocence she so craved could not possibly come from such a corrupted being.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-3}首先也是最重要的一点，Ami 没有鸡巴。虽然 Otoha 可以像 Ami 建议的那样给她戴上一个，但她总觉得那不一样。而她那么渴望的那份纯真，不可能来自一个如此堕落的存在。{/size}

lines.en: scene otohachikabath2
Secondly, Niki would probably have a problem with it. At least given the context of everything lately and how fucking Ami would be kind of like fucking Niki’s daughter.
lines.zh: 其次，Niki 大概会对此有意见。至少鉴于最近这一切的前因后果，操 Ami 在某种程度上等于操 Niki 的女儿。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath1
She still thought about it, though. And would likely think about it for another few weeks until something else happened to arouse her and she started thinking about that instead.
lines.zh: 不过她还是会想这件事。而且大概还会再想上几个星期，直到有别的东西挑起她的性欲，她就转而想那个去了。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath3
Perhaps it would even be with Chika. The enemies to lovers tag is doing numbers lately and the two of them {i}are{/i} naked right now.
lines.zh: 说不定那会跟 Chika 有关。"宿敌变恋人"这个标签最近热度很高，何况她们俩{i}现在{/i}就光着身子。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath4
Here are Chika’s boobs for posterity. Please like and subscribe.
lines.zh: 为了留念，这是 Chika 的胸。请点赞加关注。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath5
: I can’t believe the showers broke again for reasons completely unrelated to fan-service and that we have somehow found ourselves naked in the same bath.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信，淋浴又坏了——原因和福利镜头毫无关系——而我们不知怎么就光着身子在同一个浴池里了。

lines.en: : What? I just asked why you’ve been staring at me for the last five minutes.
lines.zh: : 什么？我只是问你这五分钟为什么一直盯着我看。

lines.en: : That is not even remotely close to what I heard.
lines.zh: : 这跟我听到的差了十万八千里。

lines.en: : Yeah, well if you could keep your eyes off of my chest for more than three seconds at a time, you might be able to actually understand what I’m saying to you.
lines.zh: : 是吗，那要是你能把视线从我胸口挪开超过三秒钟，你也许真能听懂我在跟你说什么。

lines.en: : Dude, you’re the one who’s been alternating between my boobs and my face since the moment you sat down.
lines.zh: : 老兄，从你坐下的那一刻起，一直在我胸和脸之间来回扫的人是你吧。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath6
: Nuh-uh. Idiot.
lines.zh: : 才没有。白痴。

lines.en: : You’re doing it literally right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在就在做。

lines.en: : Yeah, well now I’m thinking about it and they’re literally right there. Sue me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可现在我在想这件事，而它们就在那儿。告我去啊。

lines.en: : I’m feeling very violated right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在感觉受到了严重的侵犯。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath7
: GAAAAAH! Why’d it have to be {i}you{/i} of all people?! Why couldn’t I wind up here with Noriko or Yumi or-
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！为什么偏偏是{i}你{/i}？！为什么我没能跟 Noriko 或者 Yumi 或者——

lines.en: : Or Rin?
lines.zh: : 或者 Rin？

lines.en: scene otohachikabath8

: {i}No...{/i}That’s {i}not{/i} what I was going to say. And you using your past-relationship with her as leverage to make me feel bad is, like, totally fucked up. Like, can you {i}please{/i} shut up about Rin? Oh my god.
lines.zh: : {i}不……{/i}我{i}才不是{/i}要说那个。而且你拿你跟她那段过去的关系当筹码来让我难受，这他妈也太过分了。你能{i}拜托{/i}别再提 Rin 了吗？我的天啊。

lines.en: : All I did was say her name.
lines.zh: : 我不过是说了她的名字。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath9

: Fine! Well, since we’re already talking about her, I guess I can just say that it {i}would{/i} be better if she was here because {i}she{/i} wouldn’t spend the whole night making me feel like an insignificant, whiny bitch!
lines.zh: : 行！好吧，既然我们都聊到她了，那我就直说——她在这儿{i}确实{/i}会更好，因为{i}她{/i}不会整晚都让我觉得自己是个无关紧要、只会抱怨的婊子！

lines.en: : Just shut up already! Holy shit!
lines.zh: : 你给我闭嘴！我操！

lines.en: scene otohachikabath10
: Please fight with me. I need it or I’m going to think.
lines.zh: : 求你跟我吵。我需要吵架，不然我就要开始思考了。

lines.en: : You good, bro?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，老兄？

lines.en: scene otohachikabath11

: No, Otoha! I’m {i}not{/i} good! The girl I like likes the boy I like and the {i}boy{/i} I like likes {i}everyone!{/i} And it doesn’t help that you actually got to {i}be{/i} with the girl I like and {i}she{/i} got to touch your stupid perky boobs!
lines.zh: : 不好，Otoha！我{i}一点都不{/i}好！我喜欢的女孩喜欢我喜欢的男孩，而我喜欢的那个{i}男孩{/i}喜欢{i}所有人{/i}！更糟的是，你真的跟我喜欢的那个女孩{i}在一起过{/i}，而{i}她{/i}还摸过你那对又挺又蠢的胸！

lines.en: : Will...touching them make you feel better?
lines.zh: : 那……摸一摸会让你好受点吗？

lines.en: scene otohachikabath12
: {i}No.{/i} She already fucking {i}hates{/i} me and groping her ex would surely only make that worse.
lines.zh: : {i}不会。{/i}她已经{i}恨{/i}死我了，再摸她前女友只会让事情更糟。

lines.en: : Well, to be fair, you {i}did{/i} kind of bring that on yourself by suddenly cutting all ties with her. That’s not exactly a thing a person does when they want to be closer.
lines.zh: : 嗯，公平地说，那{i}确实{/i}是你自找的——你突然跟她一刀两断。想要跟一个人更亲近的人，可不会做这种事。

lines.en: : It was either that or lose myself. I was going fucking crazy. I still am. You’ve seen me.
lines.zh: : 要么那样，要么失去自我。我当时快疯了。现在也是。你都看到了。

lines.en: : More of you than I ever expected to, yeah.
lines.zh: : 看到的比我想象的多得多，是啊。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath13
: How did you do it? If...you don’t mind me asking.
lines.zh: : 你是怎么做到的？如果……你不介意我问的话。

lines.en: : What? Like, break up?
lines.zh: : 什么？比如，分手？

lines.en: : No, like...not fall completely and crazily in love with her? How did you just end it and be totally okay and not want to jump off a bridge afterward?
lines.zh: : 不，比如……没有彻底、疯狂地爱上她？你是怎么干脆利落地结束了，还完全没事，事后也不想从桥上跳下去的？

lines.en: : You really like her {i}that{/i} much? To the point where you want to jump off a bridge?
lines.zh: : 你真{i}那么{/i}喜欢她吗？喜欢到想从桥上跳下去？

lines.en: : Please don’t ask me questions that direct when I’m in the middle of trying to convince myself that I don’t feel the things I feel.
lines.zh: : 我正忙着说服自己"我没有我在感受的那些感受"呢，拜托别在这种时候问我这么直接的问题。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath14
: {i}Hah...{/i}You two really would make a good couple. Just, you’re both so blind with adoration that I worry you’d never be able to take your eyes off of each other.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}你们俩真的会很般配。只是，你们俩都被爱意蒙住了眼，我担心你们会永远舍不得把视线从对方身上移开。

lines.en: : She’s so fucking cute that I want to strangle her. But she hasn’t looked at me the way I look at her in a very long time because it’s all {i}Sensei{/i} now.
lines.zh: : 她可爱得让我想掐死她。可她已经很久没有用我看她的那种眼神看我了，因为现在满脑子都只有{i}老师{/i}。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. Sensei. The {i}other{/i} person you would have killed for until recently. Who still probably doesn’t know about your feelings for Rin.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊。老师。那位直到不久前你还愿意为其杀人的{i}另{/i}一个人。而他大概到现在还不知道你对 Rin 的感情。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath15
: I would {i}still{/i} kill for him! I love them both! But he definitely can {i}not{/i} know about this because he wouldn’t take me cheating on him half as well as I took him cheating on me!
lines.zh: : 我现在{i}依然{/i}愿意为他杀人！他们两个我都爱！但这件事绝对{i}不能{/i}让他知道，因为他要是知道我出轨，绝不会像我接受他出轨那样轻易接受！

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong here, but I heard you almost threw Yumi off your balcony.
lines.zh: : 要是我说错了你纠正我，我听说你差点把 Yumi 从你家阳台上扔下去。

lines.en: : Yeah, so just imagine what {i}he{/i} would do! Yumi would be a fucking puddle right now!
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以你想象一下{i}他{/i}会干出什么！Yumi 现在早就成了一滩烂泥了！

lines.en: : So you cheat on him with Rin and {i}Yumi{/i} winds up dying for it? Can’t say I’m the biggest fan of that girl. But even then, that seems a little unfair to me.
lines.zh: : 所以你跟 Rin 出轨，结果{i}Yumi{/i}为此送命？我可算不上那女孩的粉丝。可即便如此，这在我看来也有点不公平。

lines.en: : Just answer my question and tell me how I’m supposed to move on from her! I can’t afford to stay so invested in  a relationship that isn’t ever going to go anywhere!
lines.zh: : 你回答我的问题就好，告诉我该怎么从她身上走出来！我可承受不起继续这么投入一段永远不会有结果的关系！

lines.en: : Then why’d you choose Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么选了老师？

lines.en: scene otohachikabath16
: Well...I...
: Did you think Rin would turn you down? Were you afraid of the rejection or something?
lines.zh: : 你以为 Rin 会拒绝你？你是怕被拒绝还是什么？

lines.en: : How could I {i}not{/i} be? The last thing you want to hear when you feel that way about someone is that they don’t feel the same.
lines.zh: : 我怎么{i}可能{/i}不怕？当你对一个人有那种感觉时，最不想听到的就是对方并没有同样的感觉。

lines.en: : Rin was terrified when she confessed to you, Chika. But she did it anyway because she felt like it was worth the risk.
lines.zh: : Chika，Rin 跟你告白的时候吓得要死。可她还是做了，因为她觉得值得冒这个险。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Now, here you are stuck in a “relationship” with a man that’s openly dating your idol without a clue in the world of what to do. So much so that you’d come to me for advice despite years worth of coldness and insults.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}而现在，你困在跟一个男人所谓的"关系"里，那个人公开跟你崇拜的偶像在交往，你却完全不知道该怎么办。无知到这种地步，居然会来找我求建议，尽管我们之间冷暴力加互骂了好几年。{/size}

lines.en: : What do you want me to say, Otoha? That I’m a selfish idiot who’s afraid of change and terrified that one wrong move could cause my whole life to go up in flames? Because, there. I just said it. Now heal me.
lines.zh: : 你想让我说什么，Otoha？说我是一个自私的白痴，害怕改变，害怕一步走错就会让我的整个人生付之一炬？因为，好了。我刚说了。现在治好我吧。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath17
: I can’t {i}heal{/i} you. Hell, I can’t even offer you any advice on what I would have done in your situation because I’d never date Akira in the first place. This is all on you, dude.
lines.zh: : 我{i}治不好{/i}你。妈的，我连"换作是我会怎么做"的建议都给不了，因为我根本一开始就不会跟 Akira 谈恋爱。这全是你自己的事，老兄。

lines.en: : I didn’t know what I was doing! He was so cool and hot and...and he kept coming to see me. And, like...my {i}sister{/i} liked him. He paid for our {i}phones.{/i} It was all so fucking good and stable until it just...wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 我当时不知道自己在干什么！他又酷又帅，而且……而且他一直来看我。还有，就是……我{i}姐姐{/i}喜欢过他。他给我们付了{i}手机费{/i}。一切都那么美好、那么稳定，直到……突然就不美好了。

lines.en: : Yet you’re {i}still{/i} clinging to him. So that toxic positivity is still here even now that you’re aware your life is crashing and burning.
lines.zh: : 可你{i}到现在{/i}还抓着他不放。所以就算你已经意识到自己的人生正在崩塌燃烧，那份有毒的乐观还是在。

lines.en: : But at least now that I know what I’m in for, I can try to extinguish the blaze instead of just throwing myself into a {i}new{/i} fire. One who smells like coffee and changes her hair every season.
lines.zh: : 不过至少现在我知道自己面对的是什么了，我可以试着去扑灭这场火，而不是一头扎进{i}另一{/i}团火里。一团闻起来像咖啡、每个季节都换发型的火。

lines.en: : I can’t tell you how to get over her, Chika. Not when you’re clearly more into her than I {i}ever{/i} was.
lines.zh: : 我没法教你怎么忘掉她，Chika。尤其你明显比我{i}曾经{/i}的程度还要喜欢她。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath18

: Which, before you get mad at me, I definitely {i}was{/i} into her. And while I {i}may{/i} have said I love her, that was really just a lie I told myself to excuse the fact that I also cheated on her.
lines.zh: : 不过，在你冲我发火之前，我确实{i}曾经{/i}喜欢过她。而且虽然我{i}也许{/i}说过我爱她，那其实只是我为了给"我也对她不忠"这件事找借口，而对自己撒的谎。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath19
: You what?! With {i}who?!{/i} I’ve never heard about this! Does {i}Rin{/i} know about this?!
lines.zh: : 你什么？！跟{i}谁{/i}？！我从没听说过这件事！{i}Rin{/i}知道吗？！

lines.en: : Nope. And the only reason I’m telling you it even happened in the first place is because I know {i}you’ll{/i} be afraid of me blowing your secret to Akira in return.
lines.zh: : 不知道。而我之所以告诉你这事发生过，唯一的原因是我知道{i}你{/i}会害怕我反过来把你的秘密捅给 Akira。

lines.en: : Was it...it’s not with Sensei, right? So...Nodoka? Noriko? Who?
lines.zh: : 那是……该不会是老师吧？那么……Nodoka？Noriko？谁？

lines.en: : Some older girl. One around Akira’s age but a little younger.
lines.zh: : 某个年长的女孩。跟 Akira 差不多大，但更年轻一点。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath20
: {i}What?{/i}
: It was just once. And it was, like...not even cheating on {i}her{/i} end. I kind of just threw myself at her and hoped she’d like me back, but...nope.
lines.zh: : 就一次。而且，怎么说……在她{i}那边{/i}根本算不上出轨。我差不多是自己贴上去的，盼着她也能喜欢我，结果……并没有。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath21
: Not like nothing good came of it, though. Because that’s when I really knew how I felt about Rin. I just had to deal with a little bit of denial and shame before ever {i}accepting{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 不过也不是一点好处都没有。因为那正是我真正确定自己对 Rin 的感情的时刻。我只是得先消化掉一点否认和羞耻，才能{i}接受{/i}它。

lines.en: : It was...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: scene otohachikabath22

: It was kind of the same for me. I didn’t realize how big my feelings were until they were already out of control and I was...doing things I don’t regret, but...things I’m still ashamed of regardless.
lines.zh: : 对我来说也差不多。直到那些感情已经失控、我已经……做了一些我不后悔、但无论如何仍然感到羞耻的事之后，我才意识到它们有多大。

lines.en: : It’s okay to fuck up, you know.
lines.zh: : 搞砸了也没关系的，你知道吧。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath23
: It...is?

: At least when it comes to this stuff. Romance is, like...the one thing in my life I’m {i}not{/i} afraid to fail at. I feel like you kind of {i}need{/i} to at this age. To figure out what you want. Like, it worked for us, right?
lines.zh: : 至少在这类事情上是。恋爱是我人生里{i}唯一{/i}不怕失败的东西。我觉得在这个年纪，你有点{i}需要{/i}去失败。好弄清楚自己想要什么。比如，我们俩不就成了吗？

lines.en: : Sure, but at what cost?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可代价是什么？

lines.en: : Who {i}cares?{/i} If the cost is too great and you wind up hurting over it, just figure out what you need to do to make things {i}good{/i} again.
lines.zh: : {i}谁在乎？{/i} 要是代价太大、你因此受伤，那就想办法把事情重新变{i}好{/i}就是了。

lines.en: : It’s adversity and hardship that turn us into amazing people. Look at Beethoven. One of the greatest musicians to ever live. Deaf. Depressed. Suicidal. But he gave us Moonlight Sonata.
lines.zh: : 把我们变成了不起的人的，正是逆境和苦难。看看贝多芬。史上最伟大的音乐家之一。耳聋。抑郁。想自杀。可他给了我们《月光奏鸣曲》。

lines.en: : Without heroin, Charlie Parker never writes Relaxin’ at Camarillo. Without schizoaffective disorder, Brian Wilson never releases Pet Sounds.
lines.zh: : 没有海洛因，Charlie Parker 就写不出《Relaxin' at Camarillo》。没有分裂情感性障碍，Brian Wilson 就不会发行《宠物之声》。

lines.en: : Suffering strengthens us. You just...you know, need to deal with the fact that it might kill you too. But hey, trade-offs like that are taken by nine out of ten artists for a reason.
lines.zh: : 苦难让我们强大。你只是……你知道，得接受它也可能要了你的命这个事实。不过话说回来，十有八九的艺术家都会做这种交易，总有其理由。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath24
: I’m not an artist, though...I don’t have anything to give to the world. The only name I even recognized there was Beethoven.
lines.zh: : 可我不是艺术家……我没有什么能献给世界的东西。你刚才说的那些名字里，我只认得贝多芬。

lines.en: : Now, how am I supposed to have faith in a manager who doesn’t see what we’re doing in the light music club as art?
lines.zh: : 那我该怎么去信任一个经理——她居然不把我们轻音部在做的事看作艺术？

lines.en: scene otohachikabath25
: You’re a part of that too, dude. Don’t write yourself off just because you aren’t playing an instrument. How do you think Niki would feel about that?
lines.zh: : 你也是其中的一员啊，老兄。别因为自己没在演奏乐器就把自己划掉。你觉得 Niki 听到这话会怎么想？

lines.en: : I...that...
scene otohachikabath26
: Hey, wait a minute. How {i}do{/i} you know her? Because you two seemed kind of {i}familiar{/i} with each other on Christmalloween.
lines.zh: : 嘿，等等。你{i}到底{/i}是怎么认识她的？因为你们俩在 Christmalloween 那天看起来{i}挺熟{/i}的。

lines.en: : Through Noriko maybe? Or is this another situation like it was with Sensei where I should have already known but have just been unintentionally ignoring it for a long time?
lines.zh: : 也许是通过 Noriko？还是说这又是一桩跟老师那次一样的事——我本该早就知道，却无意中忽略了很久？

lines.en: : I think a better question is how you’re still standing after she spoke to you directly.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更好的问题是，她直接跟你说话之后，你怎么还站得住。

lines.en: : Walking does feel harder now. That’s {i}not{/i} important, though. What are you hiding?
lines.zh: : 现在连走路都更费劲了。不过那{i}不{/i}重要。你在藏什么？

lines.en: : I’ll tell you the next time the shower breaks. I don’t think you’re ready yet.
lines.zh: : 下次淋浴坏了我再告诉你。我觉得你还没准备好。

lines.en: : Otoha...
lines.zh: : Otoha……

lines.en: : If I find out that the cool older girl you cheated on Rin with is Niki...I swear to god...everything I said tonight will be invalidated and your roommate will wake up bathed in your blood. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 要是我发现你背着 Rin 出轨的那个酷酷的年长女孩就是 Niki……我对天发誓……我今晚说的每一句话都会作废，而你的室友会醒来时浑身泡在你的血里。听懂了吗？

lines.en: : Elizabeth Bathory used to do that for fun. I think Nodoka might like it as well.
lines.zh: : Elizabeth Bathory 以前就爱干这个取乐。我觉得 Nodoka 大概也会喜欢。

lines.en: : {i}Otoha.{/i} Do not {i}smile{/i} at me, you incorrigible bitch. Are you an agent from Hell sent here to corrupt every person I have ever laid my eyes on?
lines.zh: : {i}Otoha。{/i} 别{i}冲我笑{/i}，你这个不可救药的婊子。你是地狱派来的特工吗，专门来腐蚀我见过的每一个人？

lines.en: : Not all of them. I haven’t touched Akira yet. And at this rate, I feel like I’m probably going to be the last person in our class to actually do that.
lines.zh: : 不是每一个。我还没碰过 Akira 呢。而且照这个速度，我觉得我大概会是我们班上最后一个真这么做的人。

lines.en: : This implies that it {i}will{/i} happen eventually, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这暗示了它{i}终究{/i}会发生。

lines.en: : We’d be kidding ourselves if we said it won’t. This world is cursed and I exist within it to make more mistakes.
lines.zh: : 我们要是说不会，那就是在自欺欺人。这个世界是被诅咒的，而我存在于其中，就是为了犯更多的错。

lines.en: : I can’t believe I almost started liking you for a second.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信我刚才有那么一瞬间差点喜欢上你了。

lines.en: : It’s the boobs.
lines.zh: : 都是胸的功劳。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath27
: It’s like they’re toeing the line between cute and hot. The golden ratio of chests.
lines.zh: : 它们就像踩在可爱和火辣的分界线上。胸部的黄金比例。

lines.en: : Yes. Stare deeper into them and forget everything you know about Niki and me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。更深地盯进它们里去，忘掉你所知道的关于 Niki 和我的一切。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath28
: So you’re friends with Io too? How did that happen? I’ve never seen her talk to anyone but Uta and Miku.
lines.zh: : 那你也跟 Io 是朋友？怎么会？我从没见她跟 Uta 和 Miku 以外的人说过话。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say we’re {i}friends.{/i} But we were in a few classes together at Kumon-mi Academy before the whole sinkhole thing happened and she doesn’t seem to hate me.
lines.zh: : 我不会说我们是{i}朋友{/i}。不过在天坑那件事之前，我们在 Kumon-mi 学园一起上过几门课，而她看起来并不讨厌我。

lines.en: : Was your hair ever shorter? Maybe she thought you were a boy.
lines.zh: : 你以前的头发更短过吗？也许她以为你是个男孩。

lines.en: : You know, I feel like a lot of people wished I {i}was.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我觉得有挺多人希望我{i}是{/i}。

lines.en: : Sounds rough. I only got popular because I’m hot and mixed.
lines.zh: : 听着挺惨。我受欢迎只是因为我火辣，还是混血。

lines.en: : I was just talented. And also hot, I guess. Nobody really seems to care at our current school, though.
lines.zh: : 我只是有才华。大概也算火辣。不过在我们现在这所学校，好像没人真的在意。

lines.en: : They’re all just background characters anyway. No one really matters outside of 1-A. That’s why they gave us our own dorm.
lines.zh: : 反正他们都只是背景角色。1-A 之外没人真正重要。所以他们才给了我们自己的宿舍。

lines.en: : Is that not just because you’re all too loud and obnoxious for the other one?
lines.zh: : 难道不是因为你们太吵太招人烦，另一栋宿舍受不了吗？

lines.en: : No, it’s because we’re special. Stupid bitch. Listen when your manager is speaking to you.
lines.zh: : 不是，是因为我们特别。蠢婊子。听你的经理说话。

lines.en: : Apologies, madame. I didn’t realize I was talking to-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，夫人。我不知道我在跟——

lines.en: : Wha-
scene otohachikabath29
: R-Rin?! H...Heeeey!
lines.zh: : R-Rin？！嗨……嗨——呀！

lines.en: : Uhhh...wh...what are you.......umm...
: Well, {i}this{/i} definitely won’t negatively affect her at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}这{/i}绝对不会对她造成任何负面影响。

lines.en: : What...are you two doing together?...
lines.zh: : 你们两个……在干什么？……

lines.en: : We’re not! Or...we weren’t!
lines.zh: : 我们没有！或者说……我们刚才没有！

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be enemies?...
lines.zh: : 你们不是应该是死对头吗？……

lines.en: : Now you’re hanging out and {i}bathing{/i} together when you’ll barely even speak to {i}me?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 现在你们却一起玩、一起{i}洗澡{/i}，而跟我连话都几乎不肯说？……

lines.en: : Wait! This is-
lines.zh: : 等等！这是——

lines.en: : {i}We{/i} used to do that together...
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}以前也一起那样过的……

lines.en: : Rin, listen!
lines.zh: : Rin，听我说！

lines.en: : What did I do to make you hate me this much?...
lines.zh: : 我到底做了什么，让你这么恨我？……

lines.en: scene otohachikabath30
: I...It’s not like that! We just bumped into each other and...I...well...Otoha can tell you! Right, Otoha?!
lines.zh: : 我……不是那样的！我们只是碰巧撞上了，然后……我……那个……Otoha 可以跟你解释！对吧，Otoha？！

lines.en: scene otohachikabath31
: It’s true. She wouldn’t shut up about you the whole time. I almost drowned her.
lines.zh: : 是真的。她从头到尾都在说你，没停过。我差点把她淹死。

lines.en: : You could have left that part out, asshole! All you had to say was “yes!”
lines.zh: : 那部分你可以略过啊，混蛋！你只要说"是的"就行了！

lines.en: : Oh, my bad. Yes.
lines.zh: : 哦，我的错。是的。

lines.en: : Oh, {i}fuck{/i} you!
: Come on, Futaba...Chika needs her fucking {i}space.{/i}
lines.zh: : 走吧，Futaba……Chika 需要她的{i}空间{/i}。

lines.en: scene otohachikabath32
: Rin, wait! I’m sorry! I seriously don’t even {i}like{/i} Otoha!
lines.zh: : Rin，等等！对不起！我真的{i}不{/i}喜欢 Otoha！

lines.en: scene otohachikabath33
: Don’t be mad at me! Please! I miss you! I-
lines.zh: : 别生我的气！求你了！我想你！我——

lines.en: : Chika...not right now. Sorry. Just...go back to leaving her alone for the night, okay?
lines.zh: : Chika……现在不行。抱歉。就是……今晚就这么别再缠着她了，好吗？

lines.en: : {i}Futaba!{/i} We were just {i}leaving!{/i} That’s {i}it!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Futaba！{/i} 我们{i}正要离开{/i}！就{i}这样{/i}！

lines.en: scene otohachikabath34
: Wait, who the fuck is that?
lines.zh: : 等等，那他妈的是谁？

lines.en: $ otohaspring7 = True
scene bedroom_night
I open the door and immediately collapse onto the bed.
lines.zh: 我打开门，立刻瘫倒在床上。

lines.en: Being alive is exhausting.
lines.zh: 活着真累。

lines.en: scene black
I wonder how much longer I can take this for?
lines.zh: 我好奇自己还能撑多久？

lines.en: else:
jump advancetomonch4
